en.name: extend-slides
en.description: A skill that helps students transform overly simplistic courseware into a knowledge manual that can be systematically and comprehensively learned. At the same time, in order to restore the classroom content as much as possible, this skill does not reconstruct the knowledge structure but retains the original courseware context, only adding intelligent explanations. To adapt to different disciplines, there are four modes available here, corresponding respectively to courses of computational proof type, example problem-oriented type, application type and theoretical reasoning type.
